trigger_condition: An activity ping occurs with 30–55 seconds remaining on the access token.
guard_snippet: if (canRenewLastSeen(session, now())) return done(jsonOk({ ok: true }))
potential_consequence: Refresh skips rotation; replay expires an otherwise valid session.

trigger_condition: User changes country, city, state or ZIP while picked suggestion details are pending.
potential_consequence: Late details overwrite manual edits and can incorrectly restore the Verified badge.

trigger_condition: A write preflight receives HTTP 200 with malformed or missing myself identity.
potential_consequence: Unsent edits are reported saved, closing forms and discarding recoverable drafts.

trigger_condition: A later section becomes invalid while Save all awaits identity verification or earlier saves.
guard_snippet: if (!parsed.success) return Promise.resolve(invalidSaveResult()); return send(parsed.data, false)
potential_consequence: Invalid current values bypass section validation and reach the save API.
